description: Source code defining structures, enums, and functions for wake word detection and processing, including segment handling, trigger matching, and speech transcription integration.

classes.name: WakeWordSegment
classes.description: Represents a segment of wake word audio with text, timing, and range information.

classes.name: WakeWordGateConfig
classes.description: Configuration for wake word detection triggers and timing parameters.

classes.name: WakeWordGateMatch
classes.description: Result of a wake word match, including trigger end time, post-gap, and command text.

classes.name: WakeWordGate
classes.description: Contains static methods for matching wake words, generating command text, and text processing.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Matches wake word triggers within a transcript and segments based on configuration, returning a WakeWordGateMatch if successful.

methods.name: commandText
methods.description: Generates command text from segments after a trigger end time.

methods.name: matchesTextOnly
methods.description: Checks if a text contains any trigger words, case-insensitive.

methods.name: normalizeSegments
methods.description: Normalizes segments into tokens for matching.

methods.name: normalizeToken
methods.description: Converts a token to lowercase and trims punctuation and whitespace.
